title: Trump Says He’s ‘Happy’ Prince Harry, Meghan Markle Leaving US
title_cn: 特朗普表示他对哈里王子和梅根·马克尔离开美国感到“高兴”
summary: President Donald Trump celebrated Prince Harry and his wife Meghan Markle’s plans to leave the US, taking a dig at the royal couple as they return to live in the UK.

title: Bessent Blames High Energy Prices on Ukraine’s Russia Strikes
title_cn: 贝森特将乌克兰对俄罗斯的袭击归咎于高能源价格
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian energy facilities were one reason for rising global energy prices, citing those attacks before mentioning the war against Iran when asked about the elevated cost of living in the US.

title: Commerce Secretary Lutnick on AI, Anthropic and Canada Talks
title_cn: 商务部长卢特尼克谈人工智能、人类学和加拿大会谈
summary: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick lauds the benefits of artificial intelligence. Speaking with Joe Mathieu at the G20 Innovation Ministerial in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, Lutnick also says Anthropic has settled differences with the Trump administration and discusses the state of US-Canada trade negotiations. (Source: Bloomberg)
